thread:
eva: Compliance sent DSAR for user. They want full event export + proof of handling. Vendor retention is longer than our 90d.
nate: Can we avoid vendor-hosted export? Prefer we pull via vendor API into our controlled bucket.
elle: Agree. Need to ensure KMS key policy limits decryption to dsar_request context only. Also want a signed manifest.
infra-bot: Suggested flow: 1) vendor API -> service account pulls filtered events -> write to s3://priv-dsar/<id>/events.jsonl (SSE-KMS) 2) generate manifest.sha256 3) gpg sign artifact 4) grant JIT role for retrieval.
eva: RBAC question: who approves JIT role? Legal+Security?
legal-bot: Legal must approve release and retention exception if we keep longer.
ate: We'll create ephemeral role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/dsar-reader-ephemeral with GetObject limited to that prefix and require MFA. Token duration 1h.
elle: KMS snippet (draft): arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/DSAR-2026 with condition kms:EncryptionContext:dsar_id = "6135900001".
sec-ops-bot: Checklist: retention-exception ticket, signed artifact, CloudTrail evidence, two approvers for retrieval, TTL 24h default.
eva: Also request vendor vuln statement: was export endpoint affected by recent Amplitude fix? Need vendor attestation.
ate: I'll automate exporter and add a PII-scan step (regex + ML detector) before signing.
elle: Add evidence entry to PrivacyEvidence store with requester proof and redaction log.
infra-bot: Note: do not log plaintext data to CI logs. Use X-Blind placeholders in job output.
eva: Okay. Action owners: Nate -> exporter & IAM; Elle -> KMS policy + evidence store; Legal-bot -> retention-exception ticket. I'll coordinate signoff.
legal-bot: Opened RE-1120 https://re.redwood/retention-exceptions/RE-1120 (cc security).
sec-ops-bot: Final reminder: any cross-account KMS usage requires explicit principal in key policy.
eva: Thanks team — pause exports until vendor attestation received if vuln unresolved.
